scope: Safe nonbiological copper/silicon optical measurement design only

closed_services.input: material lot and approved sample specification
closed_services.excluded: Laser cutting/etching commands, beam-power tuning, exposed sharp-edge work

closed_services.input: approved experiment branch and sample carrier
closed_services.output: interlocked readiness, uncertainty and raw-measurement receipts
closed_services.excluded: Source construction, open-beam alignment, power escalation, security/interlock bypass

closed_services.output: new qualified detector epoch and safe status
closed_services.excluded: Switching under acquisition, unqualified exposure or overrange recovery

robot_safe_surface: Protected cassette handling, dock verification, declared safe service request, instrument-status observation, evidence and custody handling
abort_rule: Station controller owns safe shutdown; robot remains outside enclosure on uncertain light/energy state. No unqualified autonomous recovery.
